summary: Operator-approved Oracle tables of well locations and headers through a reviewed mapping, or any table as it is with the person's declarations; read only.

losses: Coordinates are as stored; the declared CRS is not transformed
Tables are read in pages of 1,000 rows inside one read-only transaction, up to 100,000 rows and 64 MiB
A read that outlasts the undo is refused: "The table changed while it was read; read it again"
TIMESTAMP values keep six fraction digits; further fraction digits are dropped
TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE and WITH LOCAL TIME ZONE columns refuse the read when they hold a value (the driver returns no zone)
An empty string is NULL in Oracle, so an empty identity refuses the read and an empty name is missing
CHAR and NCHAR values keep their trailing padding
Unquoted names are upper case: a configured name is used as written when it exists, else upper case; column names are as stored
Oracle connections check the certificate's subject name; alternative names are not checked by the driver
A statement the server does not interrupt can run past the time limit
unsupported: operating-system, Kerberos, wallet-only or proxy sign-in
connect descriptors, TNS aliases, SIDs and failover address lists
schema changes without a new reviewed mapping

routes.data: Any table, as its columns and rows
losses: Columns of types outside the eight logical types (spatial geometry, XMLTYPE, BLOB, CLOB, RAW and others) are listed as not read; their values are not delivered and a change in them is not detected
Declared units, descriptions, missing-value markers and coordinates are annotations; no value is converted
A table is read once inside one read-only transaction, up to 100,000 rows, 64 MiB and 128 columns
DATE is a timestamp with its time of day; TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE values are delivered in UTC without their original offset
An empty string is NULL in Oracle
CHAR and NCHAR values keep their trailing padding
Oracle connections check the certificate's subject name; alternative names are not checked by the driver
A statement the server does not interrupt can run past the time limit
unsupported: schema changes without a new reviewed declaration

redistribution: Ophiolite source; the Oracle Database is customer-operated. The python-oracledb driver (UPL-1.0 or Apache-2.0) is installed with the `databases` extra and runs in thin mode, without Oracle Client libraries.
